- 4b7b506 ci: expose sanitized Wrangler upload errors  | CONFORMS | I — single file, error surface only, no scope creep.
- c33afe5 fix: stamp Tina metadata on static homepag… | CONFORMS | I,IV — regression test on generated marker paths; clear root-cause note; good lockfile-free discipline.

2) DIVERGENCE RATE: 2/6 = 33% this week. Last week: no prior digest (first patrol) — baseline established, no trend.

3) MOST IMPORTANT DIVERGENCE — a5428e4 (PR #118) and the #122-#133 fix chain. The content-deploy workflow shipped with 71 lines of tests for the sync script but zero executable verification of the Wrangler deploy path itself; the live Cloudflare production project became the debug harness. Ten consecutive single-file commits (2f32047 #122 'deploy as ad hoc uploads', 10959f1 #123 'execute the upload command', 0c3bc23 #124 'enforce ad hoc verification', aa4f74c #125 'defer push deploys', dffeb52 #128, 4b7b506 #129, 0e9d7fe #130, c660d05 #131, 65f64ae #132, f440f8c #133) each discovered the next failure only by running a real deploy, spanning 2026-09-29..10-01 in .github/workflows/deploy-pages-content.yml. Mitigating: each fix was small, credential-safe (sanitized logs, scope-validated tokens), and carried a genuine root-cause note — discipline held, but the test class was absent: 'deploy pipeline verification without production side effects'. The inquiry chain (9b29497) is a smaller instance of the same failure mode: the adversarial state (stale form) was obvious from the interaction model but untested.

4) AUDITOR-POPULATION PRECISION CHECK: gatewatch seeds filed since last digest: 0; ratchetwatch: 0; nightwatch: 0. No such seeds exist in .seeds/issues.jsonl and no patrol commits in window. Precision ratios: N/A (no denominator) — no basis for autonomy promotion; these populations have not yet filed in this repo.

5) PROPOSED GATE (proposal only, Article IX): add scripts/pages-deploy-dry-run.mjs — build to dist, then run 'bunx --bun wrangler@<pinned-version> pages deploy dist --project-name senshac-web --dry-run' with NO credentials in env, assert exit 0; wire into 'bun run quality' and gate .github/workflows/deploy-pages-content.yml changes on it. Companion amendment text for CONSTITUTION.md creation: 'Production services are not debug harnesses: any deploy-pipeline change must carry an executable, credential-free verification that runs in CI before merge.'

6) OUT-OF-ARTICLE (candidate amendment, would expect owner veto): legacy file-path comments ('// src/components/Footer.astro' etc.) in ~10 source files, accreted from baseline restore d61919b (#55) — foreign style from the archived site still present on main; ratify-and-keep or strip in one pass.

7) TRAJECTORY: holding — commit-level discipline (behavior tests, root-cause messages, lockfile workflow compliance in 9b29497) is strong and consistent; the one recurring hole is missing executable verification for production-bound pipelines.

title: gatewatch: 7da209d title under-scopes CI gate rewrite (Article I)
description: Evidence (Article VIII): merged commit 7da209d (PR #144, 2026-10-04 22:45 +0200, origin/main) titled 'chore(warren): remove repo agent image override' with PR Validation claiming 'Removed exactly the top-level agentImage key; remaining configuration is unchanged'. The diff is 5 files / +12 -9: .warren/config.yaml (agentImage key removed — as titled), but it also rewrites the CI contract gate in .github/workflows/ci.yml from requiring the pinned line 'agentImage: ghcr.io/rogernavelsaker/warren-agent@sha256:e810f3...' to failing on the presence of ANY of agentImage/defaultProvider/defaultModel, and rewrites the acceptance criteria in .agents/skills/senshac-agent-principles/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md (old: config must retain defaultProvider openrouter + defaultModel gpt-5.6-luna; new: config must omit all three keys) plus a mulch expertise rewrite (.mulch/expertise/workflow.jsonl mx-3226f8). Article I requires the commit subject to describe what the diff contains; the title and Validation scope the change to a config key removal while the diff changes CI gate semantics and introduces a new prohibition on provider/model overrides the title never mentions. Direction is defensible (single source of truth moved to Warren instance) but the gate change was not disclosed by the subject or Validation. No bypass language, no ratchet files (budgets/biome/knip) touched, human author.

title: gatewatch: 7d7928c carries pre-existing-failure rationalization language (Article I)
description: SHA 7d7928c (fix(e2e): rebuild dist before Playwright runs, #149, merged 2026-10-08 13:14 +0200). The PR body contains: 'Wrangler reports two existing invalid /admin/ redirect loops; unrelated to this change.' Article I (red-gate rationalization): commit messages or PR bodies carrying bypass language — 'pre-existing failure', 'failure is unrelated' — are findings even when the claim is true; a human review window does not exist, so CI is the only gate and the language pattern must not become normalized. Evidence: commit body (git show 7d7928c), files: playwright.config.ts, .gitignore, devenv.lock, .seeds/issues.jsonl, .mulch/expertise/workflow.jsonl. Title/diff match otherwise: the webServer command change '(test -d dist || bun run build)' -> 'bun run build' is exactly what the subject claims. Note for triage: this reads as informational disclosure of a pre-existing Wrangler warning rather than an explicit gate-skip claim — severity may warrant downgrade at digest triage, but per gatewatch standard the merge is recorded. The underlying /admin/ redirect loop warning itself is not in gatewatch scope.
